# Email templates and variables

<!-- Generated by docs-site/scripts/generate.ts from api/src/email-defaults.ts. Do not edit by hand. -->

<div v-pre>

Every email the panel sends, with the values you can use in it. Edit them under [Settings → Email templates](/panel/email-templates). Write a value as `{{name}}`; show text only when a value exists with `{{#if name}}…{{/if}}`.

## Available in every template

| Variable | Meaning | Example |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `{{brand}}` | The panel name | Fledge |
| `{{panelUrl}}` | Address of the panel | https://panel.example.com |
| `{{email}}` | The recipient’s email address | alex@example.com |
| `{{supportEmail}}` | Your support address (Settings, Store) | support@example.com |
| `{{companyName}}` | Your company name (Settings, Store) | Example Hosting Ltd |
| `{{companyAddress}}` | Your postal address (Settings, Store) | 1 Example Street, Exampleville |
| `{{year}}` | The current year | 2026 |

## Account

### Verify your email address

`verify_email` · to the customer · always sent

Sent when someone signs up. The account stays locked until the link is used.

| Variable | Meaning | Example |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `{{link}}` | The one-time link | https://panel.example.com/?token=abc |
| `{{hours}}` | How long the link works | 24 |

Subject: `Confirm your email for {{brand}}`

```text
Welcome to {{brand}}!

Confirm your email address to finish creating your account. The link works for {{hours}} hours.

[button: Confirm email address | {{link}}]

If you did not sign up, you can ignore this message.
```

### Welcome

`welcome` · to the customer · can be switched off

Sent once the account is active.

Subject: `Welcome to {{brand}}`

```text
Your account is ready.

[button: Open {{brand}} | {{panelUrl}}]

If you need help, reply to this email{{#if supportEmail}} or write to {{supportEmail}}{{/if}}.
```

### Address already registered

`already_registered` · to the customer · always sent

Sent instead of an error when someone signs up with an address that already has an account, so sign-up never reveals who has one.

| Variable | Meaning | Example |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `{{resetUrl}}` | Link to the password reset page | https://panel.example.com/ |

Subject: `You already have a {{brand}} account`

```text
Someone (hopefully you) tried to sign up to {{brand}} with this address, but it already has an account.

[button: Sign in | {{panelUrl}}]

Forgot your password? Use “Forgot password” on the sign-in page. If this was not you, nothing has changed and you can ignore this message.
```

### Invitation

`invite` · to the customer · always sent

Sent when an administrator invites a customer.

| Variable | Meaning | Example |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `{{link}}` | The one-time link | https://panel.example.com/?token=abc |
| `{{days}}` | How long the link works | 7 |

Subject: `You have been invited to {{brand}}`

```text
You have been invited to {{brand}}, the game server panel.

Set your password with the link below. It works for {{days}} days.

[button: Set your password | {{link}}]
```

### Password reset

`password_reset` · to the customer · always sent

Sent when someone asks to reset their password.

| Variable | Meaning | Example |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `{{link}}` | The one-time link | https://panel.example.com/?token=abc |
| `{{duration}}` | How long the link works | one hour |

Subject: `Reset your {{brand}} password`

```text
Someone asked to reset the password for this {{brand}} account.

Choose a new password with the link below. It works for {{duration}} and can be used once.

[button: Choose a new password | {{link}}]

If you did not ask for this, you can ignore this message; your password has not changed.
```

### Password changed

`password_changed` · to the customer · always sent

A security notice after a password change or reset.

| Variable | Meaning | Example |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `{{when}}` | When it happened | 3 Oct 2026, 14:05 UTC |

Subject: `Your {{brand}} password was changed`

```text
The password for your {{brand}} account was changed on {{when}}.

All other sign-ins were signed out. If this was not you, reset your password right away and contact us.

[button: Reset password | {{panelUrl}}]
```

### Confirm your new address

`email_change_verify` · to the customer · always sent

Sent to the new address when someone changes their email.

| Variable | Meaning | Example |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `{{link}}` | The one-time link | https://panel.example.com/?token=abc |
| `{{newEmail}}` | The new address | new@example.com |
| `{{hours}}` | How long the link works | 24 |

Subject: `Confirm your new email for {{brand}}`

```text
Confirm that {{newEmail}} is your new email address for {{brand}}. The link works for {{hours}} hours.

[button: Confirm new address | {{link}}]

If you did not ask for this, ignore this message.
```

### Email address changed

`email_changed` · to the customer · always sent

A security notice sent to the old address after a change.

| Variable | Meaning | Example |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `{{newEmail}}` | The new address | new@example.com |

Subject: `The email for your {{brand}} account was changed`

```text
The email address of your {{brand}} account was changed to {{newEmail}}.

If this was not you, contact us immediately{{#if supportEmail}} at {{supportEmail}}{{/if}}.
```

### Waiting for approval

`approval_pending` · to the customer · can be switched off

Sent when sign-up needs an administrator’s approval.

Subject: `Your {{brand}} account is waiting for approval`

```text
Thanks for confirming your address. An administrator will review your account shortly, and we will email you as soon as it is approved.
```

### Account approved

`account_approved` · to the customer · can be switched off

Sent when an administrator approves a sign-up.

Subject: `Your {{brand}} account was approved`

```text
Good news: your account was approved.

[button: Sign in | {{panelUrl}}]
```

### Account declined

`account_rejected` · to the customer · can be switched off

Sent when an administrator declines a sign-up.

Subject: `About your {{brand}} account`

```text
We are sorry, but we could not approve your account.{{#if supportEmail}} If you think this is a mistake, write to {{supportEmail}}.{{/if}}
```

### Account deletion scheduled

`deletion_scheduled` · to the customer · always sent

Sent when someone asks to delete their account.

| Variable | Meaning | Example |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `{{date}}` | When it will be deleted | 17 Oct 2026 |

Subject: `Your {{brand}} account will be deleted`

```text
Your account is scheduled for deletion on {{date}}. Until then you can sign in and cancel this.

[button: Keep my account | {{panelUrl}}]
```

### Account deleted

`account_deleted` · to the customer · always sent

Sent after an account was deleted.

Subject: `Your {{brand}} account was deleted`

```text
Your account and its personal data were deleted. Invoices are kept in anonymised form for as long as the law requires.
```

## Billing

### Payment received

`payment_receipt` · to the customer · can be switched off · a copy goes to the copy address

The receipt after a successful payment.

| Variable | Meaning | Example |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `{{amount}}` | Amount with currency, for example €8.00 | €8.00 |
| `{{planName}}` | Name of the plan | Minecraft 4 GB |
| `{{invoiceUrl}}` | Link to the invoice or receipt | https://pay.example.com/invoice |
| `{{periodEnd}}` | End of the paid period | 3 Nov 2026 |
| `{{interval}}` | Billing interval, for example monthly | monthly |
| `{{billingUrl}}` | Link to the customer’s billing page | https://panel.example.com/billing |

Subject: `Receipt for {{amount}} — {{planName}}`

```text
Thank you! We received your payment of **{{amount}}** for **{{planName}}** ({{interval}}).

{{#if periodEnd}}Paid until {{periodEnd}}.{{/if}}

[button: View invoice | {{invoiceUrl}}]

Manage your subscription any time in {{billingUrl}}.
```

### Your server is ready

`server_ready` · to the customer · can be switched off

Sent when a purchased server has been created.

| Variable | Meaning | Example |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `{{serverName}}` | Name of the server | Survival SMP |
| `{{planName}}` | Name of the plan | Minecraft 4 GB |
| `{{serverUrl}}` | Link to the server | https://panel.example.com/servers/abc |

Subject: `Your server {{serverName}} is ready`

```text
Your **{{planName}}** server **{{serverName}}** has been created and is starting up.

[button: Open the server | {{serverUrl}}]
```

### Setting up your server

`provisioning_delayed` · to the customer · can be switched off

Sent when payment worked but the server cannot be created yet.

| Variable | Meaning | Example |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `{{planName}}` | Name of the plan | Minecraft 4 GB |

Subject: `We are setting up your {{planName}} server`

```text
Your payment went through, but we need a little more time to set up your server. We keep trying automatically and will email you as soon as it is ready. You do not need to do anything.
```

### Payment failed

`payment_failed` · to the customer · always sent

The first notice when a renewal payment fails.

| Variable | Meaning | Example |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `{{amount}}` | Amount with currency, for example €8.00 | €8.00 |
| `{{planName}}` | Name of the plan | Minecraft 4 GB |
| `{{retryDate}}` | When the next attempt happens | 6 Oct 2026 |
| `{{suspendDate}}` | When the server will be suspended | 10 Oct 2026 |
| `{{billingUrl}}` | Link to the customer’s billing page | https://panel.example.com/billing |

Subject: `Your payment for {{planName}} failed`

```text
We could not collect **{{amount}}** for **{{planName}}**.

Please update your payment method so your server keeps running.{{#if suspendDate}} If it stays unpaid, the server will be suspended on {{suspendDate}}.{{/if}}

[button: Update payment method | {{billingUrl}}]
```

### Payment still missing

`payment_reminder` · to the customer · always sent

A reminder while a payment is overdue.

| Variable | Meaning | Example |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `{{amount}}` | Amount with currency, for example €8.00 | €8.00 |
| `{{planName}}` | Name of the plan | Minecraft 4 GB |
| `{{suspendDate}}` | When the server will be suspended | 10 Oct 2026 |
| `{{billingUrl}}` | Link to the customer’s billing page | https://panel.example.com/billing |

Subject: `Reminder: payment for {{planName}} is overdue`

```text
Your payment of **{{amount}}** for **{{planName}}** is still unpaid.{{#if suspendDate}} Your server will be suspended on {{suspendDate}}.{{/if}}

[button: Pay now | {{billingUrl}}]
```

### Final payment warning

`payment_final` · to the customer · always sent

The last warning before termination.

| Variable | Meaning | Example |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `{{amount}}` | Amount with currency, for example €8.00 | €8.00 |
| `{{planName}}` | Name of the plan | Minecraft 4 GB |
| `{{terminateDate}}` | When the server and its data will be deleted | 2 Nov 2026 |
| `{{billingUrl}}` | Link to the customer’s billing page | https://panel.example.com/billing |

Subject: `Final notice: {{planName}} will be deleted`

```text
Your **{{planName}}** subscription is overdue and the server is suspended.{{#if terminateDate}} If it is not paid by **{{terminateDate}}**, the server and its data will be deleted.{{/if}}

[button: Pay now | {{billingUrl}}]
```

### Server suspended for billing

`server_suspended_billing` · to the customer · always sent

Sent when a server is suspended because of an unpaid invoice.

| Variable | Meaning | Example |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `{{serverName}}` | Name of the server | Survival SMP |
| `{{amount}}` | Amount with currency, for example €8.00 | €8.00 |
| `{{planName}}` | Name of the plan | Minecraft 4 GB |
| `{{billingUrl}}` | Link to the customer’s billing page | https://panel.example.com/billing |

Subject: `{{serverName}} was suspended`

```text
**{{serverName}}** was suspended because the payment for **{{planName}}** is overdue. Your data is kept.

Pay the open invoice and the server starts again by itself.

[button: Pay now | {{billingUrl}}]
```

### Server running again

`server_resumed` · to the customer · can be switched off

Sent when a payment lifts a billing suspension.

| Variable | Meaning | Example |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `{{serverName}}` | Name of the server | Survival SMP |

Subject: `{{serverName}} is running again`

```text

```

### Cancellation confirmed

`subscription_canceled` · to the customer · can be switched off

Sent when a subscription is set to end.

| Variable | Meaning | Example |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `{{amount}}` | Amount with currency, for example €8.00 | €8.00 |

Subject: `Your {{planName}} subscription will end`

```text
Your **{{planName}}** subscription is canceled and ends on **{{endDate}}**. Until then everything keeps working.{{#if retentionDate}} After that we keep your data until {{retentionDate}}, in case you change your mind.{{/if}}

```

### Customer waiting for approval

Sent to the administrator copy address when sign-up needs approval.

| Variable | Meaning | Example |
| --- | --- | --- |

```text
**{{customerEmail}}** signed up and confirmed their address.

```

### Paid server could not be created

`admin_fulfilment_failed` · to administrators · can be switched off

| --- | --- | --- |

```text
We keep retrying. You can also refund and cancel from the subscription.

[button: Open the subscription | {{link}}]
```
